purpose: Filled environments for web and Kotlin, preserving existing character identity

items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Edit target: the supplied KeLing pixel-art space observatory banner. Create a new fuller companion banner retaining the same mint-and-ivory robot owl astronaut identity (sprout antenna, navy glass face, cyan eyes, gold star badge, coral boots), palette, square pixel clusters and panoramic 3:1 shape. The user explicitly wants the large empty areas filled with drawn details. Replace the empty navy left half with a richly furnished learning observatory: layered bookcases, a glowing holographic knowledge globe, specimen plants in glass domes, a telescope angled toward the window, stacked notebooks, desk terminals and a winding illuminated floor path connecting the workstation to the owl on the right. Keep the ringed mint planet and smaller coral planet visible outside. Densely composed edge-to-edge, balanced large, medium and small objects, crisp stepped outlines, teal and navy structure with warm ivory and amber light. A premium cozy 32-bit game environment, not a UI mockup. No text, letters, labels, logos or watermarks. No blank copy area: web interface copy will be outside the artwork. Preserve the recognizable existing art direction; make the entire panorama visually occupied without random noise.

Overhead gold cable arcs, floating small star nodes, mechanical desk, tiled floor and shelving create a richly populated learning laboratory. Architecture is readable as a cozy room, not just floating objects.
